items.title: Airbus A350-1000ULR breaks world distance record with 24-hour non-stop flight from Australia to France | Details
items.summary: Airbus' A350-1000ULR has set a Guinness World Record after flying 12,503 nautical miles non-stop from Melbourne to Toulouse in 24 hours and 24 minutes. The aircraft is being developed for Qantas' Project Sunrise, which aims to introduce ultra-long-haul flights connecting Australia with London

items.title: Alice Huang used her relationship with Jensen Huang to move 240,000 Nvidia chips worth $7.5 billion to China: Report
items.summary: Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive, is alleged to have assisted a network of companies in acquiring and redirecting restricted Nvidia chips to China estimated to be worth $7.5 bn. Separately, Malaysian authorities seized 30 server units containing advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur Airport.

items.title: Oil rises from two-month low as Hormuz shipping attacks offset Iran truce hopes
items.summary: Oil prices rose after a two-month decline due to ongoing tensions in the Iran war and attacks on shipping. Brent futures climbed following reports of multiple attacks on vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Data indicated a significant rise in shipping incidents in October, with continued threats observed into November. Concerns remain about insurance costs and risks associated with shipping in these waters.

items.title: Gold holds near one-week low as hot US inflation boosts Fed hike bets
items.summary: Gold prices rose 0.2% to $4,039.07 per ounce in early Asian trade on Wednesday. This increase followed a nearly 3% decline in the previous session due to US inflation data. The data indicated stronger inflation, leading to heightened expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike next month. Traders now believe there is a 100% chance of an interest rate increase in December.

Both nations are close to finalizing an interim trade agreement, with few issues left to resolve.

items.title: Easing global headwinds, lower crude oil prices may further lift rupee in coming months: Economists
items.summary: Economists predict the Indian rupee will strengthen against the US dollar in the coming months. Factors contributing to this appreciation include lower crude oil prices and improving foreign capital inflows. Additionally, a weaker US dollar and the easing of geopolitical tensions are supporting this trend. The Reserve Bank of India has implemented measures to stabilize the currency and enhance dollar availability.
